status.title: Product status
status.intro: A summary of what is already resolved and what is being implemented. The platform remains in beta and this status is updated with every release.
resolved: Copilot with SSE streaming, real Stop and local conversation history
Intelligence context authorized server-side under RLS and chat memory isolated by project or investigation
Local commands (/help, /finding) and semantic cache that does not contaminate turns with memory or share responses across tenants
Own RUM with field Core Web Vitals and LCP attribution
Landing first-load about 17% faster and immutable caching for static assets
Tenant-scoped AI L2 cache, findings/audits indexes and log partitioning
/admin/usage dashboard with usage KPIs and daily chart
RLS, CSP, accessibility (axe-core) and e2e hardening
inProgress: Verified citations and anti-nag contextual suggestions in the copilot
SSE, memory and references integrated into the Intelligence sidebar
status.note: Resolved means available in the current version; in progress may change before release. Roadmap dates are estimates.
